references.text: David asks to be saved from his enemies who falsely accuse him, reflecting the situation Jesus found himself in.
Moses instructs the Israelites on how to respond when bringing a firstfruits offering, which includes a confession of faith, paralleling the high priest's requirement for a confession from Jesus.
Daniel describes a vision of 'one like a son of man' presented before God, which can be seen as a prophecy about Christ.
The prophecy about the servant who suffers in silence, which Jesus fulfills by not answering the accusations.
